label: models/fw_console.mdl: a control console, waist high, dials, two screens, a row of switches

measured.lineup: the asset is one of A to D in lineup.png beside models/sentry.mdl, models/filecabinet.mdl, models/w_egon.mdl
measured.lineupTest: asked 4 times, each in another order, which of the four was not made by Valve: judges picked A, D, C, C where the asset was D, B, B, D: passed for one of the game's

M1.reason: Outline matches a waist-high control console: a low base block with a raised back panel carrying the two screens, and a sloped control shelf in front of it. Front, left, right and back views all show the same profile, with no part sticking out or missing. Brief asks for no specific outline beyond this.

M2.reason: Height is 42.5 units against the 40 asked, 6% off, within 15%. Width 49 and depth 25.2 are the console's own proportions and the brief gives no other size for them. The measured sizeOff is 0.063.

M3.reason: Parts checked down to the small ones: two screens (LEVEL 07 and FLOW 000) in the raised back panel; eight switches in the front row (four red, four white); three round dials on the sloped top, visible in the top view and as tan discs in the front-left view; a white latch on the lower front panel; the dark vent slot along the bottom; the panel's recessed border. All are present in the right places. The dials are painted rather than modelled, but they read at the view's size, which the rubric counts as there.

M4.reason: Grey-green weathered steel body with rust streaks, dark green screens, dark switch strip with red and white switches. Matches the brief's palette of rusted steel and green-grey, with no neon or sci-fi colour.

M5.reason: Adds panel lines, edge highlights, rust streaks, the screen lettering and the switch colours, all in their places and at a sharpness that suits the other models in the line-up. Nothing wrong is added.

M6.reason: Capped at 2 by the line-up. In the four-way test the asset was never picked as the odd one out; judges picked a Valve item each time (picks A, D, C, C against the asset at D, B, B, D). Side by side at game scale it reads as a Valve console.

M7.reason: Screens and switch row face the front, the raised back is behind them, and the console stands upright on its base, sitting flat on the floor in the bottom view.

M8.reason: The check returns no errors. Triangles are 60, far under twice the Half-Life median of 238. Every visible face is closed in the six views and the below view. Screens and the sloped shelf are attached to the body, with nothing floating.
